verdict.rationale: Codegen's agent-behavior settings say agents can present a structured plan of each implementation step. Org-level permissions control whether the agent may create pull requests, and paused runs can be resumed via API, which together hint at a review-before-execution workflow. The evidence never states that the plan must be explicitly approved before the agent writes to the repository, and there is no notion of a scope or contract artifact. missing for 10: an explicit documented plan-approval gate blocking repo writes, a scope/contract definition and sign-off workflow for an engineering lead, independent or hands-on corroboration.
